snippet.title: UnGodly: Pre-Register Now | Dark Fantasy Action RPG
snippet.description:
Pre-register now on Google Play and the App Store to claim exclusive launch rewards!

UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG where brutal real-time combat, character collection, and story-driven progression collide!

Enter Tarsea, a collapsing world consumed by the Nethermaw, and build a team of Primals: powerful heroes forged through trauma, bound by elemental abilities, and driven by their own philosophies, rivalries, and emotional arcs.

Master fast, tactical combat. Swap Primals mid-battle. Chain devastating abilities. Build relationships through the Affinity system. Fight to survive the Void.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.azragames.ungodly&hl=en_US
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ungodly/id6740617332
